title: Hex isle
description: A little island of hex tiles goes through a whole day. The sun moves and casts shadows, the sky runs through sunset and blue hour into night, a windmill turns, clouds drift, and windows light up at dusk. Depth of field blurs above and below a band so it looks like a tilt-shift miniature, or it can focus on whatever is under the pointer. The tiles are from Kay Lousberg's KayKit Medieval Hexagon Pack (CC0).
line: A hex-tile island through a whole day, shot like a tilt-shift miniature.
hint: drag to orbit · wheel to zoom
